rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for doing something actively, energetically, or with strong engagement.

example.english: We actively take part in community activities.
example.traditional: 我哋積極咁參加社區活動。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 zik1 gik6 gam2 caam1 gaa1 se5 keoi1 wut6 dung6

rows.note: Use this when actively means taking the initiative rather than waiting for someone else to act.

example.english: I actively contacted the client instead of waiting for them to call me.
example.traditional: 我主動咁同個客聯絡，唔使等佢搵我。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zyu2 dung6 gam2 tung4 go3 haak3 lyun4 lok3 m4 sai2 dang2 keoi5 wan2 ngo5
